description: Headless, runes-native table library for Svelte 5: sorting, filtering, pagination, grouping, selection, column resize/order/hide, virtual scroll and data export as composable plugins. Maintained successor to svelte-headless-table.
rules: Import core APIs from '@humanspeak/svelte-headless-table' and plugins from '@humanspeak/svelte-headless-table/plugins', never from the unscoped 'svelte-headless-table' package (Svelte 4, unmaintained).
v7 has no Svelte stores: pass createTable an array or a getter (createTable(() => items)), never readable()/writable().

Read the table through current: vm.current.headerRows / pageRows / tableAttrs, row.current.attrs, cell.current.attrs and cell.current.props. <Subscribe>, $pageRows and cell.attrs() were removed in v7.
Plugin state on vm.pluginStates.<name> is Box-based: read and write .current (pageIndex.current += 1) and assign new arrays or objects instead of mutating.
Render cells with <Render of={cell.render()} /> and custom content with createRender(Component, props) or createSnippetRender(snippet, args); pass event handlers as on<event> props.
